text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: It's back around again—the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, Trainer-chan. Has Maya grown since 
we came here last year?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I see. I see, I see~☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Still, there are some things that haven't 
changed yet.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya wants to sparkle after all! Right 
here in the Twinkle Series!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer-chan, make sure you watch 
closely until the very end, okay? ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Shining brighter than anyone else—that's 
Maya!♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Brian-san! Hello there☆

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Mayano Top Gun, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat☆ You actually remembered Maya's 
name?! Waaah! I'm so happy!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Run together this many times, and 
you'd memorize it whether you wanted to or 
not.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I see. Then today, you'd better 
stay fully aware that you're racing Maya!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you so much excitement, you'll 
completely forget all your gloom and 
heartache!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'll make sure your eyes are only on me!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nihihi. Maya's actually really good at 
understanding things!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But you know, there are some things I 
don't get. Brian-san is just sparkling all 
the time.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: That's why Maya's gonna beat Brian-san.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to shine with all my might, even 
brighter than Brian-san.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And I promise I'll make it thrilling for 
you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Very well, come at me with all you have. 
I shall crush you completely."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: So there☆ Right back atcha~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: There's no way Maya's gonna lose!
